description.narrative:
I enlighet med avtalet mellan Sverige och University of Rwanda om stöd till "UR-Sweden Programme for Research, Higher Education and Institutional Development", med insatsnummer 51160027 och 51160059, kommer en programutvärdering att genomföras under det sista programåret. Halvtidsutvärderingen som var planerad till fjärde kvartalet 2015 har blivit uppskjuten vid ett flertal tillfällen och ambassaden har därför i samråd med universitetet bedömt att istället för halvtidsutvärderingen tidigarelägga den externa utvärderingen.
Utvärdering av "UR-Sweden Programme for Research, Higher Education and Institutional Advancement" kommer att genomföras enligt avtalet mellan Sverige och University of Rwanda, på Sidas bekostnad.

In accoradance with the Agreement between Sweden and the University of Rwanda on the support to the "UR-Sweden Programme for Research, Higher Education and Institutional Development", contribution number 51160027 and 51160059, a program evaluation shall be conducted during the last program year. Since the planned mid-term review that was supposed to be conducted in the fourth quarter of 2015 has been postponed several times, the Embassy - in agreement with the University of Rwanda -, has decided to have the external evaluation earlier than originally planned.
Evaluation of the UR-Sweden Program for Research, Higher Education and Instituional Advancement, in accordance with the Agreement between Sweden and the University of Rwand; Sida will carry the costs.
